blind_spots: Lexical-only check — confirms the `name:` and `description:` keys exist somewhere in the file, not that they appear inside the YAML frontmatter block. A YAML parser would be more accurate.
Bash for-loop globs literally on `skills/*/SKILL.md`; does not recurse into nested skill subdirectories.
description: On any change touching skills/, walks every skills/<name>/SKILL.md and verifies it starts with `---` and contains both `name:` and `description:` keys; regulates maintainability of skill loadability. Output is stream — one Signal per malformed SKILL.md file emitted via `BAD: <path>` lines. Auto-detected via /detect-sensors from the skills/ tree.

execution.command: for f in skills/*/SKILL.md; do head -1 "$f" | grep -q '^---$' && grep -q '^name:' "$f" && grep -q '^description:' "$f" || echo "BAD: $f"; done

name: Skill frontmatter integrity
references: Auto-generated by /detect-sensors on 2026-05-08; not in CI today.

golden_cases.notes: Empty stdout — every SKILL.md passed the head/grep check. Stream empty + exit 0 = pass/info.
Two BAD: lines (one missing frontmatter delimiter, one missing name:). Each matches the pattern → fail/medium individuals; aggregate worst-of-two = fail/medium.
